Prerequisites: Deadly Lancer class feature

Divert the crashing power of your long jump attack to instead assault the creatures behind your target. After traveling at least 10 feet as part of a long jump attack, you may choose to divert the Deadly Lancer bonus damage that would be inflicted as a 15 foot cone originating from that target, being oriented in the same direction as your attack. Targets within the area of effect take Deadly Lancer damage as slashing damage, with a Reflex save (DC: 10 + half your dragoon level + your Strength or Dexterity modifier) halving the damage.
